C0746.title: NIST Stolen Hospital Laptop Scenario Case
C0746.summary: The small-business cybersecurity scenario Stolen Hospital Laptop Causes Heartburn describes a healthcare executive leaving a work laptop with access to patient medical records in a vehicle, after which it was stolen. The organization then had to address sensitive data exposure risk and remediation. This entry is recorded as an instructional scenario case, not as a disclosed real security incident.
